staging.optimization: Keep production-equivalent controls but schedule ECS desired count zero and stop RDS outside a 60-hour weekly demo/rehearsal window, with 40 contingency hours per month.

assumptions: Optimized production uses db.t4g.small Single-AZ PostgreSQL with 20 GiB gp3, 100 GiB autoscaling maximum, private subnets, TLS, KMS, 35-day automated backup/PITR, AWS Backup, deletion protection and snapshot retention.
One 0.25-vCPU/0.5-GiB x86 Fargate task runs continuously and autoscaling permits two; a rolling deployment temporarily runs two tasks.

The private SES feedback worker and its Secrets Manager/SNS interface endpoints are aligned to one isolated AZ. SQS retains feedback during an AZ interruption; endpoint and worker AZ redundancy returns in Tier 2.
Enhanced Container Insights is disabled in Tier 1; native ECS service metrics, ALB metrics, CloudWatch logs, alarms, CloudTrail and WAF logs remain.

The logs allowance is 2.5 GiB per month, over twelve times the current observed combined monthly run rate; 90-day hot retention is used for application and operational logs while the audit trail remains 365 days.
CodeBuild assumes 60 paid build minutes and internet data transfer assumes 5 GiB. Budget/anomaly alerts catch departures from these assumptions.
All eight permanent customer-managed KMS keys and a conservative 15 USD account-security-services allowance are retained.
exclusions: Taxes, support-plan fees and third-party services
One-time production data transfer and cutover rehearsal compute
KMS rotation charges beyond the separately reported sensitivity
Traffic, log ingestion, WAF requests, email, build minutes or backup growth above the stated allowances
